hudEnabled.name: Show the bonus panel
hudEnabled.hint: Floating panel, always on top inside Foundry (shortcut: Shift+B).

forceDialog.name: Reminder in the roll window
forceDialog.hint: Opens the roll window when a bonus is engaged or available for this roll, with checkboxes to adjust at the last moment.

showBasicMoves.name: Basic move bonuses
showBasicMoves.hint: Also show bonuses tied to basic moves (Read a Bad Situation, Kick Some Ass…).

playersCanAdd.name: Players can create bonuses
playersCanAdd.hint: Off: players can only engage, spend, trigger their moves and give a bonus to another hunter. Only the GM creates and deletes.

HUD.title: Bonuses
HUD.grant: Give a bonus to another hunter
HUD.toggle: Turn on while the condition holds
HUD.arm: Engage for the next relevant roll

Dialog.title: Tracked bonuses
Dialog.hint: Checked: added to the roll. Uncheck what doesn't apply, check what does.

Form.label: Label
Form.labelPh: e.g. Help from Mark, Holy ground…
Form.reasonPh: e.g. Help Out, Kick Some Ass 10+
Form.grantHint: A forward applies to the hunter's next roll; an ongoing bonus lasts until the end of the scene.
Form.spendHint: The bonus will be added automatically to the next matching roll.

Tracker.title: Bonus tracker
Tracker.endSessionConfirm: Remove every bonus that expires at the end of the scene or session, and disengage "this roll" bonuses?

Notify.noGM: No GM connected: cannot change another character.
Notify.endScene: End of scene: scene bonuses removed.
Notify.endSession: End of session: scene and session bonuses removed.
